<!doctype html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>

<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover, user-scalable=no">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#5c0f27">
<title>مغامرات بطل قطر</title>
<style>/* مغامرات بطل قطر — interface (Arabic RTL, Tajawal, responsive 16:9, phone / tablet / desktop / smart board) */
@font-face { font-family: 'Tajawal'; src: url('data:font/woff2;base64,') format('woff2'); font-weight: 400; font-display: swap; }
@font-face { font-family: 'Tajawal'; src: url('data:font/woff2;base64,') format('woff2'); font-weight: 700; font-display: swap; }
@font-face { font-family: 'Tajawal'; src: url('data:font/woff2;base64,') format('woff2'); font-weight: 800; font-display: swap; }
:root {
  --maroon: #8a1538; --maroon-d: #5c0f27; --maroon-l: #b3244f; --gold: #f2c35a; --gold-l: #ffe39a; --gold-d: #b8862a; --pearl: #fbf8f2; --ink: #1d1a1c;
  --glass: rgba(26, 12, 20, 0.62); --glass-2: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); --line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18); --good: #1fa35b; --bad: #d8434e;
  --font: 'Tajawal', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif; --r: 20px;
  --u: clamp(10px, 1.55vmin + 0.35vmax, 26px);   /* UI unit scales with the screen (phone → 4K board) */
  --safe-t: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px); --safe-b: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px); --safe-l: env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px); --safe-r: env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px);
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: #0d0b10; color: var(--pearl); font-family: var(--font); }
body { position: fixed; inset: 0; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; font-size: var(--u); }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
#view { position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; outline: none; }
.screen { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 20; display: flex; padding: calc(var(--u) * 1 + var(--safe-t)) calc(var(--u) + var(--safe-r)) calc(var(--u) + var(--safe-b)) calc(var(--u) + var(--safe-l)); }
.screen.center { align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.screen.passthrough { pointer-events: none; }
h1, h2 { margin: 0; font-weight: 800; }
p { margin: 0.4em 0; line-height: 1.6; }
.tiny { font-size: 0.72em; opacity: 0.8; }
.warn { color: var(--gold-l); }
button { font-family: inherit; }
/* ---- buttons */
.btn { border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.62em 1.5em; font-size: 1em; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; color: var(--pearl); background: var(--glass-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); transition: transform 0.12s, background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; min-height: 2.6em; }
.btn:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18); }
.btn:active { transform: scale(0.96); }
.btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 3px; }
.btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--maroon-l), var(--maroon)); border-color: rgba(255, 220, 160, 0.45); box-shadow: 0 0.35em 0 var(--maroon-d), 0 0.8em 1.6em rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); }
.btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #c42d5b, #951a40); }
.btn-xl { font-size: 1.25em; padding: 0.7em 2.1em; }
.btn-ghost { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); }
/* ---- brand */
.brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5em; justify-content: center; }
.brand h1 { font-size: 1.9em; letter-spacing: 0; text-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--maroon-d), 0 0 18px rgba(255, 200, 120, 0.25); }
.brand.big h1 { font-size: 2.6em; }
.brand-q, .qchip { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 1.7em; height: 1.7em; border-radius: 0.3em; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a31d45, #6a0f2b); color: var(--gold-l); font-weight: 800; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.12em var(--gold), 0 0.15em 0.6em rgba(255, 190, 90, 0.45); font-size: 1.2em; }
.brand.big .brand-q { width: 1.9em; height: 1.9em; font-size: 1.6em; animation: qbob 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
.qchip { font-size: 0.9em; width: 1.5em; height: 1.5em; vertical-align: middle; }
.qchip.sm { font-size: 0.75em; }
@keyframes qbob { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(-3deg); } 50% { transform: translateY(-0.2em) rotate(3deg); } }
/* ---- loading */
#loading { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%, #3a1022 0%, #120a10 70%); z-index: 40; }
.load-card { text-align: center; width: min(92vw, 30em); }
.load-card .sub { opacity: 0.85; }
.bar { height: 0.5em; border-radius: 1em; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); overflow: hidden; margin: 1em 0 0.5em; }
.bar i { display: block; height: 100%; width: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold-d), var(--gold-l)); transition: width 0.25s; }
/* ---- menu */
#menu { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 120%, rgba(20, 8, 14, 0.0), rgba(14, 6, 12, 0.45)); }
.menu-card, .panel { background: var(--glass); backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.2); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r); box-shadow: 0 1.2em 3em rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45); padding: 1.3em 1.6em; text-align: center; max-height: calc(100vh - 2 * var(--u)); overflow: auto; }
.menu-card { width: min(94vw, 40em); }
.panel { width: min(92vw, 34em); }
.panel.small { width: auto; }
.panel h2 { margin-bottom: 0.5em; font-size: 1.5em; }
.school { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.7em; margin-bottom: 0.6em; }
.school img { width: 3.2em; height: 3.2em; object-fit: contain; border-radius: 0.6em; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); padding: 0.2em; }
.school-name { font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.05em; }
.lesson { font-weight: 700; color: var(--gold-l); font-size: 1.1em; margin-top: 0.6em; }
.start-msg { opacity: 0.92; }
.menu-actions, .panel-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.7em; justify-content: center; margin-top: 1em; }
.stage-pick { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.4em; justify-content: center; margin-top: 0.8em; }
.stage-pick button { font-size: 0.8em; padding: 0.4em 0.9em; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); color: var(--pearl); cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; }
.stage-pick button.on { background: var(--maroon); border-color: var(--gold); }
.how { text-align: right; line-height: 1.75; padding-inline-start: 1.1em; margin: 0 0 1em; }
/* ---- stage card */
.stage-card { text-align: center; padding: 1.2em 2.4em; border-radius: var(--r); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(92, 15, 39, 0.85), rgba(40, 8, 20, 0.8)); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 214, 140, 0.45); box-shadow: 0 1em 3em rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); animation: cardIn 0.6s cubic-bezier(.2, 1.4, .4, 1) both; }
.stage-card h2 { font-size: 2.3em; color: var(--gold-l); }
.stage-num { font-weight: 700; opacity: 0.85; }
@keyframes cardIn { from { transform: translateY(1em) scale(0.85); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } }
/* ---- HUD */
#hud { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 10; pointer-events: none; }
.hud-top { position: absolute; top: calc(0.6em + var(--safe-t)); left: calc(0.6em + var(--safe-l)); right: calc(0.6em + var(--safe-r)); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.5em; direction: ltr; }
.hud-group { display: flex; gap: 0.45em; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; pointer-events: auto; }
.hud-stats { direction: rtl; justify-content: flex-end; }
.hud-btn { width: 2.5em; height: 2.5em; border-radius: 0.8em; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--glass); color: #fff; display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; }
.hud-btn svg { width: 1.3em; height: 1.3em; fill: #fff; }
.hud-btn:active { transform: scale(0.94); }
.chip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35em; padding: 0.35em 0.75em; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--glass); border: 1px solid var(--line); font-weight: 800; white-space: nowrap; min-height: 2.3em; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px); }
.chip small { font-weight: 700; opacity: 0.8; font-size: 0.75em; }
.chip b { font-size: 1.05em; }
.hearts { color: #ff5a6e; letter-spacing: 0.05em; font-size: 1.05em; text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255, 60, 90, 0.4); }
.hearts .off { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25); text-shadow: none; }
.lives-ico { color: var(--gold); }
.coin-ico { width: 1.05em; height: 1.05em; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #fff2b0, #f2c13a 55%, #a87a10); box-shadow: 0 0 0.4em rgba(255, 200, 60, 0.6); }
.qprog { position: relative; }
.qprog i { display: block; width: 3.5em; height: 0.35em; border-radius: 1em; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18); overflow: hidden; }
.qprog em { display: block; height: 100%; width: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3ee08a, #b8ffcf); transition: width 0.4s; }
.hud-stage { position: absolute; top: calc(3.6em + var(--safe-t)); right: calc(0.8em + var(--safe-r)); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.8em; opacity: 0.85; text-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); }
.hint-bubble { position: absolute; top: calc(5.2em + var(--safe-t)); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: rgba(255, 246, 220, 0.96); color: var(--maroon-d); padding: 0.55em 1.1em; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 800; box-shadow: 0 0.5em 1.4em rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); white-space: nowrap; animation: hintPulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes hintPulse { 0%, 100% { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1); } 50% { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1.04); } }
.toast { position: absolute; top: 38%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); font-size: 1.6em; font-weight: 800; color: var(--gold-l); text-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--maroon-d), 0 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); animation: toastIn 0.4s cubic-bezier(.2, 1.4, .4, 1) both; white-space: nowrap; }
@keyframes toastIn { from { transform: translate(-50%, -30%) scale(0.7); opacity: 0; } to { transform: translate(-50%, -50%); opacity: 1; } }
/* score popups */
#popups { position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 12; overflow: hidden; }
.pop { position: absolute; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.05em; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55), 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); animation: popUp 0.9s ease-out forwards; white-space: nowrap; }
.pop.gold { color: var(--gold-l); } .pop.green { color: #9dffbf; font-size: 1.3em; } .pop.red { color: #ff9aa6; }
@keyframes popUp { from { opacity: 1; margin-top: 0; } to { opacity: 0; margin-top: -2.4em; } }
/* ---- question dialog */
#question { z-index: 30; background: rgba(12, 6, 10, 0.35); }
.q-card { width: min(94vw, 46em); max-height: calc(100vh - 1.5 * var(--u)); overflow: auto; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 252, 246, 0.98), rgba(246, 238, 226, 0.98)); color: var(--ink); border-radius: calc(var(--r) * 1.1); padding: 1em 1.3em 1.1em; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.25em rgba(242, 195, 90, 0.9), 0 1.5em 4em rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55); transform-origin: 50% 60%; animation: qIn 0.42s cubic-bezier(.2, 1.35, .4, 1) both; }
@keyframes qIn { from { transform: scale(0.7) translateY(1em); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } }
.q-card.shake { animation: shake 0.42s cubic-bezier(.36, .07, .19, .97); }
@keyframes shake { 10%, 90% { transform: translateX(-0.12em); } 20%, 80% { transform: translateX(0.25em); } 30%, 50%, 70% { transform: translateX(-0.45em); } 40%, 60% { transform: translateX(0.45em); } }
.q-card.good { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.3em #2fd07a, 0 0 3em rgba(47, 208, 122, 0.6), 0 1.5em 4em rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); }
.q-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6em; margin-bottom: 0.5em; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.q-badge { background: var(--maroon); color: var(--gold-l); padding: 0.25em 0.8em; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.85em; }
.q-stage { font-weight: 700; color: #6d5f63; font-size: 0.8em; }
.q-tries { margin-inline-start: auto; font-weight: 700; color: #8a6a2a; font-size: 0.8em; }
.q-timer { position: relative; height: 0.65em; border-radius: 1em; background: #eadfcd; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 0.6em; }
.q-timer i { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1fa35b, #8fe0a8); transition: width 0.2s linear; }
.q-timer.urgent i { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #d8434e, #ff9aa6); }
.q-timer span { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 0.6em; font-weight: 800; color: #3a2a20; }
.q-body { display: flex; gap: 1em; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 0.8em; }
.q-image { max-width: 38%; max-height: 32vh; border-radius: 0.8em; object-fit: contain; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0.3em 1em rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15); }
.q-text { font-size: 1.45em; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; flex: 1; }
.q-options { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0.6em; }
.q-options.two { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
.opt { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6em; text-align: right; padding: 0.7em 0.9em; border-radius: 0.9em; border: 2px solid #e2d4bd; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font-size: 1.12em; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; min-height: 3.1em; transition: transform 0.1s, border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s; }
.opt:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--gold-d); background: #fffaf0; }
.opt:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(0.98); }
.opt:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--maroon); outline-offset: 2px; }
.opt-l { flex: none; width: 1.9em; height: 1.9em; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--maroon); color: var(--gold-l); font-weight: 800; }
.opt-t { flex: 1; }
.opt.tf { justify-content: center; font-size: 1.3em; }
.opt.wrong { border-color: var(--bad); background: #fff0f1; color: #8a2a32; opacity: 0.7; }
.opt.wrong .opt-l { background: var(--bad); color: #fff; }
.opt.right { border-color: var(--good); background: #eafff2; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2em rgba(31, 163, 91, 0.25); }
.opt.right .opt-l { background: var(--good); color: #fff; }
.opt:disabled { cursor: default; }
.q-feedback { min-height: 1.6em; margin-top: 0.6em; font-weight: 800; text-align: center; font-size: 1.05em; }
.q-feedback.good { color: var(--good); } .q-feedback.bad { color: var(--bad); } .q-feedback.info { color: #7a5a1a; }
/* ---- results */
.stars { font-size: 2.6em; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--gold); text-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(255, 200, 80, 0.6); }
.stars .off { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); text-shadow: none; }
.stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(7.5em, 1fr)); gap: 0.5em; margin: 0.9em 0; }
.stat { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0.9em; padding: 0.5em; }
.stat b { display: block; font-size: 1.4em; color: var(--gold-l); }
.stat small { opacity: 0.85; }
.celebrate h2 { font-size: 1.9em; color: var(--gold-l); }
.trophy { font-size: 3em; animation: qbob 2s ease-in-out infinite; }
.cert-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6em; font-weight: 800; }
.cert-head img { width: 2.8em; height: 2.8em; object-fit: contain; background: #fff; border-radius: 0.5em; padding: 0.15em; }
/* ---- settings */
.settings { display: grid; gap: 0.7em; text-align: right; margin: 0.6em 0 0.4em; }
.settings label { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7em 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 0.6em; font-weight: 700; }
.settings label.row { display: flex; }
.settings input[type=range] { width: 100%; accent-color: var(--gold); }
.settings select { font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.9em; padding: 0.35em; border-radius: 0.5em; }
.settings input[type=checkbox] { width: 1.2em; height: 1.2em; accent-color: var(--maroon-l); }
/* ---- touch controls (physical left = move, right = jump; never covers the hero or the question) */
#controls { position: fixed; inset: auto 0 0 0; z-index: 15; pointer-events: none; height: 0; direction: ltr; }
.pad { pointer-events: auto; position: fixed; bottom: calc(1.1em + var(--safe-b)); width: 4.9em; height: 4.9em; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45); background: rgba(20, 10, 16, 0.32); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px); display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; touch-action: none; }
.pad svg { width: 2.3em; height: 2.3em; fill: none; stroke: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92); stroke-width: 2.6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.pad.on { background: rgba(138, 21, 56, 0.6); border-color: var(--gold); }
.pad-move .pad:first-child { left: calc(1.1em + var(--safe-l)); }
.pad-move .pad:last-child { left: calc(6.8em + var(--safe-l)); }
.pad-jump { right: calc(1.4em + var(--safe-r)); width: 5.8em; height: 5.8em; }
.pad-jump svg { fill: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92); stroke: none; }
body[data-phase=question] #controls, body[data-phase=menu] #controls { display: none; }
.rot-ico { font-size: 3em; animation: spin 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes spin { 50% { transform: rotate(90deg); } }
.spinner { width: 2em; height: 2em; border-radius: 50%; border: 0.25em solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); border-top-color: var(--gold); animation: sp 0.8s linear infinite; margin: 0 auto 0.6em; }
@keyframes sp { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
/* compact landscape phones */
@media (max-height: 430px) {
  :root { --u: clamp(9px, 2.6vmin + 0.2vmax, 15px); }
  .q-text { font-size: 1.25em; } .opt { min-height: 2.6em; padding: 0.5em 0.7em; } .q-image { max-height: 26vh; }
  .brand.big h1 { font-size: 2em; } .menu-card { padding: 0.8em 1.1em; }
}
@media (max-width: 560px) { .q-options { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .q-options.two { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; } }
@media print {
  body { position: static; background: #fff; color: #000; }
  #view, #hud, #controls, #popups, .screen:not(#final) { display: none !important; }
  #final { position: static; display: block !important; }
  #final .panel { background: #fff; color: #000; box-shadow: none; border: 3px double #8a1538; width: 100%; backdrop-filter: none; }
  #final .panel-actions { display: none; }
  .stat { border-color: #ccc; } .stat b, .celebrate h2 { color: #8a1538; }
}
</style>

</head>
<body data-phase="boot">

<canvas id="view" aria-label="عالم اللعبة"></canvas>

<div id="loading" class="screen center">
  <div class="load-card">
    <div class="brand"><span class="brand-q">؟</span><h1>مغامرات بطل قطر</h1></div>
    <p class="sub">جارٍ تجهيز عالم المغامرة…</p>
    <div class="bar"><i id="loadFill"></i></div>
    <p id="loadMsg" class="tiny"></p>
  </div>
</div>

<section id="menu" class="screen center" hidden>
  <div class="menu-card">
    <header class="school">
      <img id="schoolLogo" alt="" hidden>
      <div><div id="schoolName" class="school-name"></div><div id="teacherLine" class="tiny"></div></div>
    </header>
    <div class="brand big"><span class="brand-q">؟</span><h1>مغامرات بطل قطر</h1></div>
    <p id="lessonLine" class="lesson"></p>
    <p id="startMsg" class="start-msg"></p>
    <div id="stagePick" class="stage-pick"></div>
    <div class="menu-actions">
      <button id="btnStart" class="btn btn-primary btn-xl" type="button">ابدأ المغامرة</button>
      <button id="btnHow" class="btn btn-ghost" type="button">طريقة اللعب</button>
      <button id="btnTeacher" class="btn btn-ghost" type="button">لوحة المعلم</button>
    </div>
    <div id="sampleNote" class="tiny warn" hidden>الأسئلة الحالية تجريبية — يمكن للمعلم إضافة أسئلة الدرس من «لوحة المعلم».</div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="how" class="screen center" hidden>
  <div class="panel">
    <h2>طريقة اللعب</h2>
    <ul class="how">
      <li><b>الحركة:</b> الأسهم ← → أو A / D، أو أزرار الشاشة.</li>
      <li><b>القفز:</b> ↑ أو W أو المسافة. اضغط مطوّلًا لقفزة أعلى.</li>
      <li><b>مكعب السؤال <span class="qchip">؟</span>:</b> قف تحته واقفز لتضربه برأسك، ثم اختر الإجابة الصحيحة ليُفتح الطريق.</li>
      <li><b>الأعداء:</b> اقفز فوق السلطعون والنورس لتتخطاهما، وابتعد عن قنفذ البحر الشائك.</li>
      <li><b>القلوب والمحاولات:</b> كل إصابة تُفقدك قلبًا، والسقوط في الماء يُفقدك محاولة وتعود إلى آخر نقطة حفظ.</li>
      <li><b>اختصارات:</b> P إيقاف مؤقت · M كتم الصوت · F شاشة كاملة · ١–٤ لاختيار الإجابة.</li>
    </ul>
    <button class="btn btn-primary" data-close="how" type="button">فهمت</button>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="stageCard" class="screen center passthrough" hidden>
  <div class="stage-card">
    <div id="stageNum" class="stage-num"></div>
    <h2 id="stageTitle"></h2>
    <p id="stageIntro"></p>
  </div>
</section>

<div id="hud" hidden>
  <div class="hud-top">
    <div class="hud-group">
      <button id="btnPause" class="hud-btn" type="button" aria-label="إيقاف مؤقت"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M7 5h3v14H7zM14 5h3v14h-3z"/></svg></button>
      <button id="btnFull" class="hud-btn" type="button" aria-label="شاشة كاملة"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 9V4h5v2H6v3zm11-5h5v5h-2V6h-3zM6 15v3h3v2H4v-5zm12 0h2v5h-5v-2h3z"/></svg></button>
      <button id="btnMute" class="hud-btn" type="button" aria-label="الصوت"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path id="muteIcon" d="M4 9v6h4l5 4V5L8 9zm12.5 3a4.5 4.5 0 0 0-2.5-4v8a4.5 4.5 0 0 0 2.5-4z"/></svg></button>
    </div>
    <div class="hud-group hud-stats">
      <div class="chip" title="القلوب"><span id="hudHearts" class="hearts"></span></div>
      <div class="chip" title="المحاولات"><span class="lives-ico">♛</span><b id="hudLives">٣</b></div>
      <div class="chip" title="العملات"><span class="coin-ico"></span><b id="hudCoins">٠</b></div>
      <div class="chip" title="النقاط"><small>النقاط</small><b id="hudScore">٠</b></div>
      <div class="chip qprog" title="الأسئلة"><span class="qchip sm">؟</span><b id="hudQ">٠/٠</b><i><em id="hudQFill"></em></i></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="hudStage" class="hud-stage"></div>
  <div id="hintBubble" class="hint-bubble" hidden><span class="qchip sm">؟</span> الجري تلقائي — المس الشاشة للقفز وضرب مكعب السؤال</div>
  <div id="toast" class="toast" hidden></div>
</div>

<section id="question" class="screen center" hidden role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="qText">
  <div class="q-card">
    <div class="q-head">
      <span id="qBadge" class="q-badge"></span>
      <span id="qStage" class="q-stage"></span>
      <span id="qTries" class="q-tries"></span>
    </div>
    <div id="qTimer" class="q-timer" hidden><i id="qTimerFill"></i><span id="qTimerTxt"></span></div>
    <div class="q-body">
      <img id="qImage" class="q-image" alt="صورة السؤال" hidden>
      <p id="qText" class="q-text"></p>
    </div>
    <div id="qOptions" class="q-options"></div>
    <div id="qFeedback" class="q-feedback" aria-live="polite"></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="platformWait" class="screen center passthrough" hidden>
  <div class="panel small"><div class="spinner"></div><p>أجب عن السؤال في نافذة المنصة…</p></div>
</section>

<section id="pause" class="screen center" hidden>
  <div class="panel">
    <h2>إيقاف مؤقت</h2>
    <div class="settings">
      <label>الموسيقى <input id="volMusic" type="range" min="0" max="1" step="0.05"></label>
      <label>المؤثرات <input id="volSfx" type="range" min="0" max="1" step="0.05"></label>
      <label class="row"><input id="chkMute" type="checkbox"> كتم كل الأصوات</label>
      <label class="row"><input id="chkControls" type="checkbox"> أزرار التحكم على الشاشة</label>
      <label>الجودة <select id="selQuality"><option value="auto">تلقائية</option><option value="high">عالية</option><option value="medium">متوسطة</option><option value="low">منخفضة (للأجهزة البطيئة والسبورة)</option></select></label>
    </div>
    <div class="panel-actions">
      <button id="btnResume" class="btn btn-primary" type="button">متابعة</button>
      <button id="btnRestartStage" class="btn btn-ghost" type="button">إعادة المرحلة</button>
      <button id="btnMenu" class="btn btn-ghost" type="button">القائمة الرئيسية</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="stageClear" class="screen center" hidden>
  <div class="panel celebrate">
    <div id="scStars" class="stars"></div>
    <h2 id="scTitle">أكملت المرحلة!</h2>
    <div id="scStats" class="stats"></div>
    <button id="btnNext" class="btn btn-primary btn-xl" type="button">المرحلة التالية</button>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="gameOver" class="screen center" hidden>
  <div class="panel">
    <h2>انتهت المحاولات</h2>
    <p>لا بأس يا بطل! أسئلتك المحلولة محفوظة، جرّب مرة أخرى.</p>
    <div class="panel-actions">
      <button id="btnRetry" class="btn btn-primary btn-xl" type="button">حاول مجددًا</button>
      <button id="btnGoMenu" class="btn btn-ghost" type="button">القائمة الرئيسية</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="final" class="screen center" hidden>
  <div class="panel celebrate cert">
    <div class="cert-head"><img id="finalLogo" alt="" hidden><div id="finalSchool"></div></div>
    <div class="trophy">🏆</div>
    <h2>بطل قطر!</h2>
    <p id="finalMsg"></p>
    <div id="finalStats" class="stats"></div>
    <div class="panel-actions">
      <button id="btnAgain" class="btn btn-primary btn-xl" type="button">العب مجددًا</button>
      <button id="btnPrint" class="btn btn-ghost" type="button">طباعة الشهادة</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div id="controls" hidden>
  <div class="pad-move">
    <button class="pad" data-ctl="left" type="button" aria-label="يسار"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M15 5 8 12l7 7"/></svg></button>
    <button class="pad" data-ctl="right" type="button" aria-label="يمين"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m9 5 7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
  </div>
  <button class="pad pad-jump" data-ctl="jump" type="button" aria-label="قفز"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 5 5 13h4v6h6v-6h4z"/></svg></button>
</div>
<div id="rotate" class="screen center" hidden><div class="panel small"><div class="rot-ico">⟲</div><p>أدر الجهاز أفقيًا للعب بشاشة أوسع</p><button class="btn btn-ghost" id="btnRotateOk" type="button">متابعة على أي حال</button></div></div>
<div id="popups" aria-hidden="true"></div>
